title: Commercial Credit Account Hold, Returned Payment and Collections Thresholds
content:
**Collections standard — thresholds per terms tier of the Commercial Credit Account.** Amounts in USD.

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due of the oldest open undisputed invoice that place a credit hold | 15 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 |
| Minimum undisputed past-due balance for a past-due hold | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Past-due hold released only when the whole past-due balance is paid | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Amounts under an open dispute excluded from the past-due balance | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Returned payments within the lookback that place the account on hold | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Returned payment lookback, months ending on the current date | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Fee per returned payment | 35.00 | 35.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Months after a returned payment with no checks accepted | 6 | 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Days past due of the oldest open undisputed invoice for collections referral | 60 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 120 | 150 |
| Minimum undisputed past-due balance for collections referral | 250.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |

### Line notes

- **Hold days and minimum** — days past the due date of the oldest open undisputed invoice at which a credit hold is placed, and the minimum undisputed past-due balance below which no past-due credit hold is placed.
- **Full past-due required** — "yes": a past-due hold is released only when the whole past-due balance is paid; "no": released once the remaining past-due balance is below the tier's minimum past-due balance for a hold.
- **Disputed amounts excluded** — "yes": amounts under an open dispute are excluded from the past-due balance used for hold and finance charge decisions.
- **Returned payments** — the number of returned payments within the lookback window that places the account on hold; the rolling lookback in months ending on the current date over which returned payments are counted; the fee charged per returned (NSF, closed account or stopped) payment.
- **Certified funds** — months after a returned payment during which payments are accepted only by ACH debit, wire or card (no checks).
- **Collections referral** — days past due of the oldest open undisputed invoice, and the minimum undisputed past-due balance, at which an on-hold account is referred to Collections.

### Q&A on the schedule

**Does the Corbett Net 10 Starter Account exclude disputed amounts?** No. Its line reads "no", so a disputed amount stays in its past-due balance.

**How many returned payments put a Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account on hold?** Three within its 12-month lookback.
